title: rubus coriifrons
intro: Rubus coriifrons, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry, is a species of thorny shrub native to the Himalayas. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine, offering numerous health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which aid in reducing fever, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rubus coriifrons include its use as a diuretic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-spasmodic agent, while its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of Rubus coriifrons.
